title: My Brother Sold My $680K Inheritance For $5K. So I Watched Him Repot In 'Rooted In Fraud' Vest.
description: I poured my $108K nursing pension into a historic orchid conservatory with my brother. He forged a dissolution, sold my share for $680K, and gave me a $5K 'plant food' check. I found the original agreement hidden in a glass cloche, voided the sale, and now he reports to me every Saturday repotting orchids in a 'Rooted in Fraud' vest. #Revenge #FamilyBetrayal #OrchidConservatory
thumb_text: HE SOLD MY $680K INHERITANCE FOR $5K, NOW WEARS 'ROOTED IN FRAUD'
pinned_comment: If your own brother sold your $680,000 inheritance and tried to hand you a $5,000 plant food check, what would you have done? Share your story in the comments.
